commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+9' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) wastes a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cameroon will have a goal kick.
90+8' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
90+7' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
90+3' An infringement by Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) results in a yellow card and as it's the second time today, he also sees a red and is dismissed by Ismail Elfath.

90+2' 1 - 0 Jerome Ngom Mbekeli sends a superb cross into the box. Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom right corner, leaving Ederson beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Brazil is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' Dani Alves (Brazil) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
89' Pedro (Brazil) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jerome Ngom Mbekeli (Cameroon) will replace Nicolas Moumi Ngamaleu.
85' Ismail Elfath shows a yellow card to Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) for a tough tackle.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brazil.

84' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes out of play. Brazil are awarded a corner kick.
83' The free kick is taken by Dani Alves (Brazil), but ball is cleared.
81' A yellow card for a tackle by Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon). Ismail Elfath doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' Karl Toko Ekambi (Cameroon) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
80' The corner from Karl Toko Ekambi (Cameroon) is cleared away by the defence.
80' Collins Fai (Cameroon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Cameroon.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Raphinha (Brazil) coming on for Antony.
78' Olivier Ntcham (Cameroon) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Ederson.
76' The attendance for today's match is 85986.
73' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
71' Antony (Brazil) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
68' The game has come to an end for Pierre Kunde. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Olivier Ntcham (Cameroon).
67' Everton Ribeiro (Brazil) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
65' Devis Epassy is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Dani Alves (Brazil). Easy save!
64' Tite has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pedro (Brazil) replacing Gabriel Jesus.
64' Substitution. Bryan Mbeumo is replaced by Karl Toko Ekambi (Cameroon).
63' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
60' Dani Alves (Brazil) was too forceful with his tackle and Ismail Elfath interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
59' The game is interrupted now, Devis Epassy (Cameroon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brazil will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' The goalkeeper dives to deny Antony (Brazil), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post. The linesman makes the right call and Brazil will have a corner.
58' Brazil take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

57' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Bremer (Brazil) inside the box and he manages to steer it low to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Devis Epassy makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score. The ball is out of play. Brazil will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' Antony (Brazil) takes the corner but it's cleared.

56' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Devis Epassy sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brazil.
54' Substitution. Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fred walks off.
54' Everton Ribeiro (Brazil) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrygo.
54' Tite prepares a substitution. Alex Telles is replaced by Marquinhos (Brazil).

54' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brazil.

54' Cameroon are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
51' Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brazil.
48' Alex Telles (Brazil) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cameroon comes to nothing.
47' Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
47' The ball is cleared after Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' A header by Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon) from very close range goes towards the top left corner, but doesn't get past Ederson, who makes a brilliant save.
45+2' Rodrygo (Brazil) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
45+2' Antony (Brazil) will deliver the corner kick.

45+1' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Devis Epassy thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
45' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
43' Dani Alves (Brazil) commits a foul and Ismail Elfath immediately signals a free kick.
41' Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Ederson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
38' Collins Fai (Cameroon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Antony (Brazil) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Devis Epassy makes a comfortable save.
37' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Cameroon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

33' Dani Alves (Brazil) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
32' Collins Fai (Cameroon) sees a yellow card from Ismail Elfath after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
29' Rodrygo (Brazil) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
28' Ismail Elfath shows the yellow card to Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) for a heavy challenge.
26' Brazil take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
25' A lofted cross from Antony (Brazil) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Brazil force their opponents to concede a corner.
25' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
23' Rodrygo (Brazil) prepares to take a corner kick.
22' Rodrygo (Brazil) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Brazil will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Fred (Brazil) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
21' Andre Zambo Anguissa (Cameroon) commits a rough foul. Ismail Elfath stops the game and makes a call.
20' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Cameroon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' The corner from Antony (Brazil) is intercepted by the defence.
17' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

15' Gabriel Jesus (Brazil) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cameroon will have a goal kick.
15' Rodrygo (Brazil) is about to take a corner kick.

14' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Devis Epassy, who pulls off a stunning save! Brazil earn a corner.
12' Antony (Brazil) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
10' The linesman signals that Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
7' The foul by Eder Militao (Brazil) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ismail Elfath.
6' Nouhou Tolo (Cameroon) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
4' Ismail Elfath blows for a foul after Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
2' Rodrygo (Brazil) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

2' Brazil exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye. It's a throw-in for Cameroon.
